aggregation.accuracy: balanced synthetic binary cue recall, 24 held-out episodes per seed/panel
aggregation.credit_loss_sign: final minus initial held-out loss; negative is improvement
aggregation.environments: same three seeds repeated in two environments; do not pool as six independent seeds
aggregation.retention_sign: earlier minus later proxy score; negative is improvement
aggregation.unit: one seed; within-seed panel means are averaged across the three declared seeds
aggregation.variance: sample variance with denominator n-1; descriptive only, no significance or confidence claim
